definition: to cover a window with wooden planks
description: On a seaside promenade a huge brown dust storm rolls in behind palm trees. A young man in a blue shirt, cargo shorts, work boots and a white vest presses a sheet of plywood over the window of a small pink ice-cream kiosk with one hand and hammers a nail into it. Then he turns his head and stares at the approaching storm in alarm. The kiosk's other window is already covered with two crossed planks, and stacked plywood boards and loose planks lie on the paving while people walk a dog behind.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er vernagelt das Fenster mit Brettern.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está tapando la ventana con tablas.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il cloue des planches sur la fenêtre.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
